description: Fetch the full lexical entry and word study for a single Strong's number (e.g. 'H7563', 'G2316'). Returns lemma, transliteration, pronunciation, KJV definition, `word_study`, and `grammatical_forms` — the word's part of speech plus how it actually inflects across all its occurrences in Scripture (each form with its occurrence count, most frequent first). Use `grammatical_forms` to ground claims about how a word is used grammatically (e.g. "most often a Piel — an intensive stem") rather than generalizing from memory. `word_study` is an essay written with AI in 2025 and partly reviewed since: the definition, forms and occurrence count are the recorded data, and a verse the essay cites for a word may not contain it, so check with get_strongs_for_verse or get_strongs_occurrences before saying it does. Call this AFTER get_strongs_for_verse when you need to go deeper on a specific word.
name: get_strongs_detail
title: Strong's entry and word study
